s: Seder aseret yeme teshuba ubo h' seipim: mitannin lemochorat rosh hashshana vehu taanit tzibbur kemo shennitbaer besiman tqm"t, vekol hilkotayv nitbaer besiman tq"n ayyen sham:

Vekol hayyamim shebben rosh hashshana leyom hakkippurim marbim bitpilla vetachanunim. Venohagim lomar "abinu malkenu ku'" ereb vaboqer, millebad beshabbat, veken beereb shabbat achar mincha en omerim oto, kemo shennitbaer besiman (tqtz"b) [tqp"d]:
Veomerim bekol yom chutz mishshabbat g' peamim vidduy qodem alot hashshachar, millebad beereb yom hakkippurim sheen omerim oto ella paam achat:
Im era mila ben rosh hashshana leyom hakkippurim en omerim tachanun velo "vehu rachum ku'", abal omerim "abinu malkenu" (ve"el erek appayim" ve"lamnatztzeach"):

En notenim cherem ben rosh hashshana leyom hakkippurim, shello leorer kochot haddin bazzeman hahu. Veken en mashbiin adam bebet din bayyamim haellu, shello lehabi onesh shebua laolam chas veshalom. Abal laasot din ben adam lachabero — bevadday mitzva rabba yesh ladun ulehotzi haggezela mittachat yado, shekkesheyyesh din lematta — en din lemala. Veim yesh eseq shebua benehem — yannichuhu ad leachar yom hakkippurim:
